assessment.name: Year 10 Spanish Autumn assessments (Edexcel GCSE)
assessment.sections: Monday 30 November, period 5: Chromebook assessment (listening and reading). Wednesday 2 December, period 1: reading and writing, including translation.
assessment.weighting: Autumn 1: Media and technology. Autumn 2: My personal world (family, relationships, friends). Grammar across three time frames is assessed in the writing.

mock.note: 30 vocabulary, grammar and translation questions. For writing, use the Written practice tab and time yourself.

units.name: My personal world: family, relationships, friends

cards.title: Mobile phones and technology
cards.question: How do you say what you use your phone and technology for, and give an opinion?
points: Uso mi móvil para (I use my phone to) + infinitive: chatear con mis amigos, sacar fotos, escuchar música, ver vídeos, buscar información.
Paso dos horas al día en línea. (I spend two hours a day online.)
No podría vivir sin mi móvil. (I could not live without my phone.)
Lo bueno es que ... Lo malo es que ... (The good thing is that ... The bad thing is that ...)

example.heading: Model sentence
lines: Uso mi móvil para chatear con mis amigos, pero lo malo es que paso demasiado tiempo en línea.

cards.watch_out: Para + infinitive means in order to. Do not conjugate the second verb: para sacar, not para saco.
cards.hook: Lo bueno, lo malo: the good, the bad, then your verdict.
cards.grade9: Use a conditional to show range: Sin mi móvil, me sentiría aislado (Without my phone, I would feel isolated).

cards.title: Social media and the internet: pros and cons
cards.question: How do you discuss the advantages and dangers of social media and the internet?
points: las redes sociales (social media), subir fotos (to upload photos), compartir (to share), descargar (to download).
Ventajas: mantenerse en contacto, es útil para los deberes, es entretenido.
Desventajas: el ciberacoso (cyberbullying), la adicción, los desconocidos (strangers), perder el tiempo.
Es importante no compartir datos personales. (It is important not to share personal details.)
cards.watch_out: Las redes sociales is plural, so use son, not es: Las redes sociales son peligrosas.
cards.grade9: Balance an argument: Por un lado ..., por otro lado ..., en mi opinión ...

cards.title: TV, film and streaming
cards.question: How do you talk about types of programmes and films and what you watched?
points: las comedias, los dramas, los documentales, los concursos (game shows), las películas de terror, de acción, de ciencia ficción, los dibujos animados (cartoons).
Prefiero ver series en plataformas de streaming porque puedo verlas cuando quiero.
El fin de semana pasado vi una película de acción. Fue emocionante.
Opinion adjectives: emocionante, aburrido, gracioso (funny), informativo, entretenido.
cards.watch_out: Vi (I saw) and fue (it was) have no accent. Vi is the preterite of ver.
cards.grade9: Add a recommendation: Te recomiendo esta serie porque los actores son muy buenos.

cards.title: Music and reading
cards.question: How do you describe the music you like and what you read?
points: Me encanta la música pop, el rap, la música clásica. Mi cantante favorito es ...
Escucho música cuando voy al colegio. Toco la guitarra desde hace dos años.
Leo novelas, revistas, cómics, libros electrónicos. Leo en mi tableta.
Cuando era pequeño leía cómics, pero ahora prefiero las novelas. (imperfect then present)
cards.watch_out: Desde hace with the present tense means for a time that is still going on: Toco la guitarra desde hace dos años (I have played the guitar for two years).
cards.hook: Tocar for instruments, jugar for games.
cards.grade9: Use a contrast of time frames in one sentence, as in the cuando era pequeño example, to show control of tenses.

cards.title: How technology has changed
cards.question: How do you compare technology in the past and now?
points: Antes (before), ahora (now), en el futuro (in the future).
Antes la gente escribía cartas; ahora mandamos mensajes.
Es más rápido que antes, pero menos personal.
En el futuro creo que usaremos más la inteligencia artificial.
cards.watch_out: Use the imperfect (escribía) for what used to happen, not the preterite.
cards.grade9: Three time frames in one paragraph: antes, ahora, en el futuro. Examiners look for this in the top band.

cards.title: My family
cards.question: How do you describe your family members?
points: mi padre, mi madre, mi hermano mayor (older brother), mi hermana menor (younger sister), mis abuelos, mi tío, mi primo.
Step family: mi padrastro, mi madrastra, mi hermanastro. Hijo único (only child).
Somos cinco en mi familia. (There are five of us in my family.)
Mi hermano se llama Bhavin y tiene doce años.
cards.watch_out: Mis padres means my parents, not my fathers. Los padres covers mother and father together.
cards.hook: Mayor is older, menor is younger: major and minor.
cards.grade9: Use relative clauses: Tengo un hermano que se llama Bhavin y que es muy deportivo.

cards.title: Describing people: appearance and personality
cards.question: How do you describe what someone looks like and what they are like?
points: Appearance with tener and ser: Tiene el pelo negro y los ojos marrones. Es alto y delgado. Lleva gafas.
Personality with ser: es simpático, gracioso, trabajador, paciente, generoso, egoísta, perezoso, tímido.
Adjectives agree: mi madre es simpática; mis primos son graciosos.
Intensifiers: muy, bastante (quite), un poco, demasiado (too).
cards.watch_out: Use ser for personality and appearance, but estar for moods: Es tranquilo (calm person) but está cansado (tired now).
cards.hook: Ser for what you are, estar for how you are.
cards.grade9: Use comparatives: Mi hermano es más alto que yo pero menos paciente que mi madre.

cards.title: Relationships
cards.question: How do you say how you get on with family and friends?
points: Me llevo bien con (I get on well with) mi madre. Me llevo mal con mi hermano.
Nos llevamos bien. (We get on well.) Nos peleamos a veces. (We sometimes fight.)
Discutimos (we argue) sobre las tareas de casa. Mi padre me apoya (supports me).
Mi madre me entiende. Mi hermano me molesta (annoys me).
cards.watch_out: Llevarse is reflexive. I get on is me llevo, he gets on is se lleva, we get on is nos llevamos.
cards.hook: Me llevo bien: I carry myself well with someone.
cards.grade9: Give a past example: Ayer mi hermano y yo nos peleamos porque usó mi móvil sin permiso.

cards.title: Friendship and what makes a good friend
cards.question: How do you describe your best friend and what makes a good friend?
points: Mi mejor amigo se llama ... Lo conozco desde hace cinco años. (I have known him for five years.)
Un buen amigo es alguien que (someone who) me escucha, me apoya y me hace reír.
Para mí, lo más importante es la confianza (trust) y la lealtad (loyalty).
Compartimos los mismos intereses. Siempre está ahí para mí.
cards.watch_out: Alguien que is followed by a normal present tense verb here: alguien que escucha, not alguien escuchar.
cards.grade9: Add a hypothetical: Un buen amigo nunca diría mis secretos (A good friend would never tell my secrets).

cards.title: Role models
cards.question: How do you describe a role model and say why you admire them?
points: Mi modelo a seguir es ... (My role model is ...)
Lo admiro porque es trabajador y ayuda a los demás. (I admire him because ...)
La admiro porque ha superado muchos obstáculos. (She has overcome many obstacles.)
Me inspira a trabajar más. (He or she inspires me to work harder.)
cards.watch_out: Use lo for him and la for her before admiro: Lo admiro, La admiro.
cards.grade9: Use the perfect tense (ha superado, ha ganado) to give achievements. It is a fourth tense in your writing.

cards.title: Future family and marriage
cards.question: How do you say whether you would like to get married or have children in the future?
points: En el futuro me gustaría casarme (to get married). No quiero tener hijos.
Prefiero vivir en pareja sin casarme. (I prefer to live as a couple without marrying.)
Cuando sea mayor, tendré dos hijos. (When I am older, I will have two children.)
Para mí, casarse no es importante; lo importante es ser feliz.
cards.watch_out: Cuando sea mayor uses the subjunctive sea, not es, because it is about the future.
cards.hook: Cuando sea: a learned chunk worth top marks.
cards.grade9: Use si clauses: Si encuentro a la persona ideal, me casaré.

cards.title: Present tense: regular and key irregular verbs
cards.question: What are the present tense endings and the key irregular verbs?
points: -ar: hablo, hablas, habla, hablamos, habláis, hablan. -er: como, comes, come. -ir: vivo, vives, vive, vivimos.
ser: soy, eres, es, somos, sois, son. estar: estoy, estás, está.
tener: tengo, tienes, tiene. ir: voy, vas, va. hacer: hago.
Stem changers: jugar → juego, preferir → prefiero, poder → puedo.
cards.watch_out: Stem changers do not change in the we form: podemos, preferimos, jugamos.
cards.hook: Boot verbs: the change happens inside the boot shape (I, you, he, they), not in we or you plural.
cards.grade9: Use a range of irregulars accurately. Range plus accuracy is what lifts writing into the top band.

cards.title: Preterite tense (completed past)
cards.question: How do you form the preterite tense for what you did?
points: -ar: hablé, hablaste, habló, hablamos, hablaron. -er and -ir: comí, comiste, comió, comimos, comieron.
ir and ser: fui, fuiste, fue, fuimos, fueron. hacer: hice, hizo. ver: vi, vio. tener: tuve.
Time markers: ayer, el fin de semana pasado, el año pasado, hace dos días.
Spelling changes: jugar → jugué, sacar → saqué, llegar → llegué.
cards.watch_out: The accent matters: hablo (I speak) but habló (he spoke).
cards.hook: Fui means both I went and I was. Context decides.
cards.grade9: Combine preterite with an opinion in the past: Fui al cine y me encantó la película.

cards.title: Imperfect tense (used to, was)
cards.question: How do you form and use the imperfect tense?
points: -ar: jugaba, jugabas, jugaba, jugábamos, jugaban. -er and -ir: comía, comías, comía, comíamos, comían.
Only three irregulars: ser (era), ir (iba), ver (veía).
Use it for repeated past actions (used to) and descriptions: Cuando era pequeño, jugaba al fútbol.
Era divertido. Había mucha gente. (There were lots of people.)
cards.watch_out: Use the preterite for one finished action (fui al cine ayer), the imperfect for habits (iba al cine cada semana).
cards.hook: Imperfect = in the past, again and again.
cards.grade9: Use both in one sentence: Mientras veía la tele, sonó mi móvil (While I was watching TV, my phone rang).

cards.title: Future and conditional
cards.question: How do you talk about the future and what you would do?
points: Near future: ir a + infinitive. Voy a ver una película. Vamos a salir.
Simple future: add -é, -ás, -á, -emos, -án to the infinitive. Jugaré, viviré, será.
Irregular future stems: tendré, haré, podré, saldré.
Conditional: add -ía to the infinitive. Me gustaría, viviría, sería, tendría.
cards.watch_out: Do not forget a in ir a + infinitive: voy a jugar, not voy jugar.
cards.hook: Future uses the whole infinitive as its stem: jugar + é = jugaré.
cards.grade9: Use the conditional for ideas: Sería genial tener más tiempo libre.

cards.title: Opinions and justifications
cards.question: How do you give developed opinions with reasons?
points: Me gusta, me encanta, me interesa, me molesta, odio + noun or infinitive.
With a plural noun: me gustan las comedias, me encantan los videojuegos.
Pienso que, creo que, en mi opinión, para mí, a mi modo de ver.
Reasons: porque, ya que, puesto que (since), dado que, sin embargo (however), además (furthermore).
cards.watch_out: Me gusta becomes me gustan before a plural noun. It agrees with the thing liked, not with you.
cards.hook: One opinion, one reason, one connective: every sentence.
cards.grade9: Add a past opinion and a future opinion: me gustó, me gustaría.

cards.title: Negatives, comparatives and other high level structures
cards.question: Which extra structures make your Spanish stand out?
points: Negatives: no ... nunca, no ... nada, no ... nadie, ya no (no longer). Ya no juego al fútbol.
Comparatives: más ... que, menos ... que, tan ... como. Superlative: el más interesante.
Acabo de + infinitive: I have just. Acabo de comprar un móvil.
Antes de + infinitive and después de + infinitive: Después de cenar, veo la tele.
cards.watch_out: Spanish uses a double negative: No veo nada (I do not see anything).
cards.grade9: Use lo que (what): Lo que más me gusta es ... It opens sentences in an impressive way.

cards.title: Reading and listening strategies
cards.question: How do you get the most marks in the reading and listening questions?
points: Read the questions first and predict the vocabulary you will need.
Watch for negatives and time markers, which change the meaning: nunca, ya no, antes, ahora.
Look for cognates (words like English), but beware false friends: embarazada means pregnant, not embarrassed.
Answer in the language of the question. English questions need English answers.
cards.watch_out: Distractors are common: a text may mention three things, but only one answers the question.
cards.grade9: Infer meaning from context for unknown words and check your answer makes sense in the whole sentence.

cards.title: Translation into English and into Spanish
cards.question: How do you translate accurately for full marks?
points: Into English: translate every word, keep the tense and person the same, write natural English.
Into Spanish: check tense, verb ending, gender and agreement for every word.
Look for the grammar the sentence is testing: a past tense, a negative, a comparative, an opinion.
Do not leave gaps; a sensible guess can still score.

example.heading: Translate: Last week I watched a funny film with my sister.
lines: La semana pasada vi una película graciosa con mi hermana.

cards.watch_out: Película is feminine, so the adjective is graciosa. Agreement errors are the most common translation slip.
cards.grade9: Read your Spanish translation back slowly and check each verb, accent and agreement once more.

cards.title: Writing for the top band
cards.question: How do you plan and write a high scoring answer?
points: Cover every bullet point in the task. Each one usually needs a different tense.
Each paragraph: a fact, an opinion with a reason, and a time frame.
Include present, past and future, plus at least one conditional or other complex structure.
Stay close to the word count and check verbs, accents and agreement at the end.
cards.watch_out: Missing a bullet point caps your mark, however good the Spanish is.
cards.hook: PPF: Present, Past, Future in every answer.
cards.grade9: Use a learned set of high level phrases once each, such as Lo que más me gusta es, Si tuviera más tiempo, Cuando sea mayor.

cards.title: Writing toolkit
cards.question: Which phrases should be in your writing on Wednesday?
points: Present: Me llevo bien con mi madre porque me apoya.
Past: El fin de semana pasado vi una serie con mi hermano. Me encantó.
Imperfect: Cuando era pequeño, jugaba a los videojuegos todos los días.
Future and conditional: En el futuro voy a usar menos el móvil. Me gustaría casarme.
Opinion and connectives: Lo bueno es que ..., sin embargo ..., además ...
cards.watch_out: Check every accent at the end: fui, vi and fue have none; jugué, habló and comí do.

written.q: Write about 90 words in Spanish about your family and friends. Mention: who is in your family; how you get on with them; something you did together recently; your plans for the future.
model: Family members with correct gender and agreement (1)
Description of personality or appearance using ser or tener (1)
How you get on, using me llevo bien or mal con (1)
Opinion with a reason and a connective (1)
Past event in the preterite, such as fuimos or vimos (2)
Future plan using voy a or the future tense (1)
One complex structure, such as cuando sea mayor or me gustaría (1)
Accurate verbs, accents and agreement throughout (2)

written.q: Write about 90 words in Spanish about technology. Mention: how you use your phone; the advantages and disadvantages of social media; what technology was like in the past; how you will use technology in the future.
model: Present tense uses with para + infinitive (1)
Advantages and disadvantages with lo bueno and lo malo (2)
Opinion with a justification (1)
Imperfect for the past, such as antes la gente escribía (2)
Future or conditional for the future (1)
Range of connectives (1)
Accurate verbs, accents and agreement (2)

written.q: Translate into Spanish: My brother is younger than me. We get on well but sometimes we argue. Yesterday we watched a documentary. In the future I would like to have a dog.
model: Mi hermano es menor que yo. (1)
Nos llevamos bien (1)
pero a veces discutimos. (1)
Ayer vimos un documental. (1)
En el futuro (1)
me gustaría tener un perro. (1)

written.q: Translate into English: Cuando era pequeño, no tenía móvil. Ahora uso las redes sociales todos los días, pero lo malo es que paso demasiado tiempo en línea.
model: When I was little (1)
I did not have a phone. (1)
Now I use social media every day, (1)
but the bad thing is (1)
that I spend too much time (1)
online. (1)

exam_tips.timing: Wednesday: about 25 minutes on reading, 25 on writing. Monday: read each question before the recording or text.
section_a: Read questions first and underline the key words.
Look out for negatives, time markers and opinions, which often change the answer.
Answer in the language of the question.
section_b: Cover every bullet point, each in a different tense where possible.
Use one opinion and one reason per sentence.
Leave 3 minutes to check accents, agreement and verb endings.
grade9: Cover every bullet point. Tick each one only after you have written a clear sentence about it.
Show past, present and future accurately before trying anything harder: juego, jugué, voy a jugar.
Add a reason or a detail to every main idea: Me gusta porque me ayuda a relajarme.
In reading, check the words around the keyword. Negatives and words like aunque can flip the meaning.
Be accurate first; complex Spanish full of errors scores less than simple, correct Spanish.
Then add one conditional, one si clause and varied connectives (además, sin embargo, ya que).

mcq.q: How do you say I use my phone to take photos?
mcq.a: Uso mi móvil para sacar fotos
w: Uso mi móvil para saco fotos
Uso mi móvil por sacar fotos
mcq.e: Para + infinitive means in order to.

mcq.q: What does el ciberacoso mean?
mcq.e: Acoso means bullying or harassment.

mcq.q: What does descargar mean?
mcq.e: Subir is to upload, compartir is to share.

mcq.q: Which sentence is correct?
mcq.e: Redes is feminine plural, so son and peligrosas.

mcq.q: What does Paso dos horas al día en línea mean?
mcq.a: I spend two hours a day online
w: I spent two hours online yesterday
I go online twice a day
mcq.e: Pasar tiempo means to spend time.

mcq.q: What are los dibujos animados?
mcq.e: Dibujos animados are animated drawings.

mcq.q: What are los concursos?
mcq.e: Concursos on TV are quiz and game shows.

mcq.q: What does Toco la guitarra desde hace dos años mean?
mcq.a: I have played the guitar for two years
w: I played the guitar two years ago
I will play the guitar for two years
I stopped playing the guitar two years ago
mcq.e: Desde hace + present tense for something still going on.

mcq.q: What does Lo malo es que mean?
mcq.e: Lo + adjective means the ... thing.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses the imperfect correctly?
w: Antes la gente escribió cartas ayer
Antes la gente escribe cartas mañana
mcq.e: Imperfect for what used to happen.

mcq.q: What does No podría vivir sin mi móvil mean?
mcq.a: I could not live without my phone
w: I cannot live with my phone
I would live without my phone
I did not live without my phone
mcq.e: Podría is the conditional of poder.

mcq.q: What is mi hermanastro?
mcq.e: Padrastro, madrastra, hermanastro: step family.

mcq.q: What does hijo único mean?
mcq.e: Único means only.

mcq.q: What does mi hermana menor mean?
mcq.e: Menor is younger, mayor is older.

mcq.q: How do you say I get on well with my mother?
mcq.a: Me llevo bien con mi madre
w: Me lleva bien con mi madre
Me llevo bueno con mi madre
mcq.e: Llevarse bien con is reflexive.

mcq.q: How do you say We sometimes fight?
mcq.e: Nos for we with a reflexive verb.

mcq.q: What does Mi padre me apoya mean?
w: My father helps me with homework
mcq.e: Apoyar means to support.

mcq.q: What does me molesta mean?
mcq.e: Molestar is a false friend; it means to annoy.

mcq.q: Which describes a mood rather than a personality?
mcq.e: Estar is for temporary states and moods.

mcq.q: How do you say My cousins are funny?
mcq.e: Plural noun, so plural verb and adjective.

mcq.q: What does Lo conozco desde hace cinco años mean?
mcq.a: I have known him for five years
w: I met him five years ago
I will know him in five years
I knew him for five years
mcq.e: Desde hace + present for an ongoing time.

mcq.q: What does la confianza mean?
mcq.e: Lealtad is loyalty.

mcq.q: How do you say I admire her?
mcq.e: La is her as a direct object.

mcq.q: What does Cuando sea mayor mean?
w: When I am bigger than him
mcq.e: Cuando + subjunctive for the future.

mcq.q: What does casarse mean?
mcq.e: Casarse con alguien: to marry someone.

mcq.q: What is I go in Spanish?
mcq.e: Ir is irregular: voy, vas, va.

mcq.q: What is we can in Spanish?
mcq.e: Stem changers do not change in the we form.

mcq.q: What is I played (football) in the preterite?
mcq.e: Spelling change g to gu before é.

mcq.q: What does fuimos mean?
mcq.e: Ir and ser share the preterite.

mcq.q: Which is the preterite of hacer for he or she?
mcq.e: Hacer is irregular: hice, hiciste, hizo.

mcq.q: What does jugaba mean?
mcq.e: Imperfect: repeated past action.

mcq.q: Which three verbs are irregular in the imperfect?
mcq.e: Era, iba, veía.

mcq.q: Which is the near future?
mcq.e: Ir a + infinitive.

mcq.q: What is I will have?
mcq.e: Irregular future stem tendr-.

mcq.q: What does Me gustaría mean?
mcq.e: Conditional of gustar.

mcq.q: Complete: Me ___ las comedias.
mcq.e: Plural noun, so gustan.

mcq.q: What does Ya no juego al fútbol mean?
w: I do not play football yet
mcq.e: Ya no means no longer.

mcq.q: What does Acabo de comprar un móvil mean?
mcq.a: I have just bought a phone
w: I am going to buy a phone
I bought a phone last year
mcq.e: Acabar de + infinitive means to have just.

mcq.q: What does puesto que mean?
mcq.e: It introduces a reason, like ya que.

mcq.q: What does embarazada mean?
mcq.e: A false friend.

mcq.q: In what language should you answer English questions on a Spanish reading paper?
mcq.e: Answer in the language of the question.

mcq.q: Translate: Last week I watched a funny film with my sister.
mcq.a: La semana pasada vi una película graciosa con mi hermana.
w: La semana pasada veo una película gracioso con mi hermana.
La semana pasado vi un película graciosa con mi hermano.
La semana pasada vía una película graciosa con mi hermana.
mcq.e: Preterite vi, feminine película and graciosa.

mcq.q: What does PPF stand for in writing?
mcq.e: Use three time frames in every answer.

mcq.q: What happens if you miss a bullet point in a writing task?
w: It is ignored if your Spanish is good
mcq.e: Every bullet must be covered.

vocab.example: Para mí, la confianza es lo más importante en una amistad.
Es importante apoyar a tus amigos cuando tienen problemas.
Puede molestar mucho cuando mi hermano usa mi móvil.
Prefiero descargar música en lugar de comprar discos.
No es buena idea compartir datos personales en línea.
Hablar con desconocidos en línea puede ser peligroso.
Nunca hablo con un desconocido en las redes sociales.
La lealtad es la cualidad más importante de un buen amigo.
Es normal pelearse con los hermanos a veces.
Para mí, casarse no es importante; lo importante es ser feliz.
